notes.title: Cole Hunter: Payback now playable during Debut Festival
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702099/558d5be207a6cabd41111fd94aaa45ed2950a905.png"]Cole Hunter: Payback is now playable during Steam Debut Festival 2025.
From Thursday Aug 7 at 11 am PDT to Monday Aug 11 at 11 am PDT our playtest will be OPEN ACCESS - no wait, no key, just click and play.

What’s in the build

1 planet, 2 variants, one full boss and a horde of enemies

First ship with 5 implicit abilities (weapons)

No NDA, stream, record, and share your runs


(If you are already on the waiting list - you’re in. Access will be granted automatically when the festival begins.)


We need your feedback!

Share your comments on our Survey or jump into our Discord to tell us what you think, report bugs, or show off your craziest builds.


Enjoy the festival, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist so you’ll be first in line when the campaign launches.


Captain Hunter wishes you a fun time!
